# Tanker Shipping

## Bi-Weekly Industry Report

### April 21, 2026

- **Straits Still Shut as Negotiations Continue -** Headlines remain mixed and confidence in a near term resolution is fragile, keeping transit through the Strait of Hormuz effectively constrained. Against this backdrop, AG fixing remains largely stalled. While some enquiry persists, uncertainty around transit risk continues to limit participation and stems are slow to progress.
